description: Re-hosts images on Webcake's CDN (statics.pancake.vn) and returns a map from each original entry to its hosted URL. Accepts up to 20 entries per call, processed in parallel, up to 200 MB each: http(s) image URLs, data:image/…;base64 URIs, and — only when the server runs locally over stdio — local file paths (absolute, ~/, file://, or Windows drive paths; rejected per entry on the remote HTTP transport). Upload target: with Webcake credentials and a resolved organization, each image is filed into that organization's media collection (the library the Webcake editor's media picker shows) and marked collection:true with its asset_id; without credentials the public CDN endpoint is used (the URL works, but the image is not in any collection: collection:false). Organization resolution: organization_id, then WEBCAKE_ORG_ID / x-webcake-org-id, then automatic selection when the account has exactly one organization; with two or more and none given, the result is ok:false with reason:'organization_required' and the organization list. dry_run defaults to false, because this only adds images to the media library and changes no page data; dry_run:true lists what would be processed without any network or filesystem access.

dry_run.description: Default FALSE — the call actually reads/downloads and uploads, returning hosted URLs. Set true to only preview the endpoint and entries that WOULD be processed, without any network or filesystem activity (local paths: reports whether the file exists and its size).

in_folder.description: Collection folder id to file the uploaded assets into (the media library's folder). Omit to use the account's root folder. Ignored when the upload falls back to the public CDN endpoint (no credentials).

organization_id.description: Organization whose media collection receives the images — normally the organization the page lives in. Optional when WEBCAKE_ORG_ID / x-webcake-org-id is set or the account has exactly one organization; with two or more and none given, the result is reason:'organization_required' with the organization list. Ignored without credentials (public CDN fallback).

urls.description:
Image sources to upload — 1–20 per call. Accepted formats:
• http(s) URLs (remote images to download and re-host)
• data:image/...;base64,... URIs (inline image data)
• Local file paths from the user's machine: absolute POSIX paths (/home/user/photo.jpg), home-dir paths (~/Pictures/logo.png), file:// URIs, or Windows drive paths (C:\Users\…). Local paths are only allowed when the server runs in stdio mode (the user's own machine); they are rejected on the remote HTTP transport.
Up to 200 MB per image (the backend multipart limit).

name: upload_images
